name: Google Pixel 3a
notes: wlan0 ath10k_snoc comes up with EEPROM regdomain 0x0, which the ath driver maps to CTRY_UNITED_STATES, hard-disabling ch 12/13 in 2.4 GHz. Our patch maps unprogrammed EEPROMs to WOR5_ETSIC (0x65) and uses ath_world_regdom_63_65 as custom base so channels 12/13 remain enabled. Verified 2026-10-18: a WPA2 network on channel 13 (2472 MHz) connects with options cfg80211 ieee80211_regdom=DE. 5 GHz (DFS ch 116) crashes wlan firmware (halphy_caldb.c assertion) — separate issue, not fixed by the regdom patch. Runtime USB role switching works with the stock kernel: a boot-DTB-only change (dr_mode=otg, usb-role-switch, role-switch-default-mode=host) exposes /sys/class/usb_role/a600000.usb-role-switch/role which switches live between host and device without reboot. Verified 2026-10-19: host mode enumerates a powered hub, RTL8152 Ethernet, video adapter and card reader (/dev/sda); device mode releases the port and the UDC returns. Boot default is device. VBUS without an externally powered hub is untested.

Codename asteroids, model A059P, platform volcano. Measured on mb003: ro.soc.model=SM7635, Android 15 V3.1-250112-1904, kernel 6.1.84-android14, bootloader unlocked. Official GPL source NothingOSS/android_kernel_msm-6.1_nothing_sm7635 has volcano and volcano-qrd-pro DTs under arch/arm64/boot/dts/vendor/qcom. The exact 250112 build was not found in the published V3.1 history (earliest observed release 250302). Device package is in this tree (device-nothing-asteroids plus linux-omnipha-nothing-sm7635 pinned to commit d5f5f965fd0b478eaf4eb63fd984c5a4a92135a7). No mainline DT in the inspected upstream tree; no Omnipha image or successful Omnipha boot. Debug attempts returned to fastboot with no observed USB/SSH; they do not establish kernel execution. See mission issue.
